versions.changelog:
Initial release of byted-mediakit-video.

- Provides 14 video processing capabilities, including video enhancement, video understanding, subtitle erasure, scene segmentation, and more.
- Supports tasks like analyzing video highlights, extracting storyline, ASR subtitles, enhancing or generatively repairing video quality, and removing subtitles.
- Includes specialized tools for green screen/portrait matting, video OCR, and metadata probing.
- All features require mediakit-cli and are triggered via the video domain.
